title: See this
body:
Dear Apple Team,

I am extremely disappointed with my iPad experience. Despite being a loyal user, I am facing multiple issues that make it impossible to enjoy my favorite games and apps:
	1.	Frequent crashes and app restarts – Heavy games, including open-world car and plane games, lag constantly and restart unexpectedly. This disrupts gameplay and ruins the experience.
	2.	Limited freedom and restrictions – Unlike other devices (e.g., Samsung), I cannot install mods, enjoy full open-world features, or freely customize my games.
	3.	Hardware issues – My cracked screen further complicates use, making precise gameplay impossible.
	4.	Overall frustration – These issues have forced me to quit games I love, including Brawl Stars, solely because iPad/iOS limitations prevent me from playing as intended.

I feel that the device and software are restrictive, frustrating, and fail to provide the gaming experience promised. I request that Apple addresses these issues seriously, as they directly impact user satisfaction and usability.
author: Talal mutasem

title: Medications failed
body: Impossible to track medications in the app. The schedule constantly gets messed up — whatever you set: every day, every two days, or every three days. After some time it just stops following the schedule, skips reminders, or shifts them randomly. Restarting or reinstalling doesn’t help. Honestly, it’s easier to track medications on paper than use this app.

title: Really helpful in my understanding of my body - help me more with a new feature integration 💡
body:
I’m sure i’m not using it to its fullest potential, but to the features that matter to my case, using them almost feels like im saving my life by understanding my body and building habits to keep it going. 

I hope the medications log has a weekly, monthly, and yearly views. I think this is particularly important in comparing the skipped days and say, the momentary moods and mood for the day. And time under the sunlight as well!

Like overlapping graphs to see trends and make correlations

This would be super helpful in reporting medication consistency or in inconsistency, what are the other surrounding elements that the watch can measure. 🤍🤍

I actually wanna make this a tool for my psychiatric visits.
